messages:
vikas: Quick sync: prototype run showed allocator lock contention and DMA queue buildup when tiny-page churn spiked after the offload threshold change.

elaine: Symptom details? syscalls, madvise, or lock contention?

vikas: Mostly slow mmap/madvise on alloc slowpath and long pin_waits. Trace: `kvcache.lookup -> alloc_slowpath -> mmap -> pin_wait -> dma_submit`. Global host-pool mutex was the hot spot.

tom: Classic tiny allocation thrash. Proposal: tiny-slab arena for <=512B slots, pre-pinned, per-GPU/per-NUMA, lockless freelist fastpath.

joanne: Pre-pinning helps latency but increases host resident pages. Need worst-case host memory budget and eviction protocol.

vikas: Eviction sketch: slabs are epoch-marked. To evict we stop new allocs into slab, background compact copies live slots to fresh slab then async unpin old slab. Fastpath never blocks on eviction.

elaine: Metrics we need: slab_free_percent, slab_reuse_rate, slab_compact_ops, slab_eviction_backoff. Also a slab-level frag_score = 1 - (largest_contig_free / total_free).

tom: Add tenant QoS tokens: each tenant gets token bucket for tiny-allocs to prevent noisy neighbor exhaustion. If tokens depleted, fallback to regular allocator. Token checkout is atomic and cheap.

vikas: Microbatch coalescing still useful: it amortizes DMA submit overhead. With tiny-slab, many pins become no-ops but coalescing reduces staged DMA bursts.

joanne: Compaction controller should be load-aware (not static rate). Suggest controller tie: target dma_queue_util < 30% and host_cpu_idle > 15% before aggressive compaction. Use backoff if queue grows.

elaine: Risks: page alignment vs hugepage boundaries, kernel madvise collapsing, race with eviction when slab pages are promoted. Need pin-reference protocol and safe unmap sequence.

infra-bot: Created RFC-2024-19: "tiny-slab preallocated allocator + tenant QoS tokens" assigned [vikas, elaine, joanne].

vikas: Next steps: open PR for lockless freelist fastpath, instrument slab metrics, and add token-bucket limiter. We'll run staged stress harness next week behind a feature flag.

joanne: I'll build the harness with eviction pressure + mixed workloads (tiny KV + long gens) and report p95/p99 tails.

eliane: I'll draft telemetry + compaction PID controller spec (typo: "elaine" will own).

vikas: Great. If the prototype holds we can enable for a subset of tenants. Monitor host mem and tail latencies closely before wider rollout. :rocket:
